ValidationRule.description: Only requires Asked for Referral on cases that are worked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT(ISPICKVAL( Completed_Conversation_Exhausted__c ,"Never Worked" )), (ISPICKVAL(Status, "closed" )), (ISPICKVAL( Asked_for_Referral__c , "")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Customer_Support_Type__c, "Referral Credit")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Customer_Support_Type__c, "DNC Request")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select an option for this field.
